{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'

print('\nNumber of -1 in customer_age:', (sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

print('\nUnique revenue values (first 10):', sales['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print('\nQA orders found:', len(qa_orders))
print('QA order IDs:', qa_orders['order_id'].tolist())

# Check status
print('\nStatus distribution:', sales['status'].value_counts())"}
